rule.name: ReceiverPassedAsArgument
rule.message: A call passes its own receiver as an argument (defaults.putAll(defaults), node.setPeer(node)). Another variable of the same type is in scope, so the author most likely typed the wrong name: the call is then a no-op or corrupts the object, and the intended argument is never used. Pass the variable that was meant (defaults.putAll(transientVariables)). An exception fits a method that really takes the object it is called on, such as a self-registration or a self-comparison in a contract test.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $typeOf := function($id) { string-join($id/ancestor::*[self::FormalParameter or self::LocalVariableDeclaration or self::FieldDeclaration][1] /*[self::ClassType or self::PrimitiveType or self::ArrayType] /descendant-or-self::*/(@SimpleName | @Kind | self::ArrayDimensions/@Size), ',') } return //MethodCall[ArgumentList/@Size = 1][ArgumentList/VariableAccess][*[1][self::VariableAccess]] [matches(@MethodName, '^(set|put|add|remove|register|append|insert|link|attach|assign|bind|apply|update|with)([A-Z]|$)')] [not(@MethodName = ('addAll', 'removeAll', 'add'))] [not(matches(@MethodName, '(Next|Prev|Previous|Head|Tail|Link|Parent|List)([A-Z]|$)'))] [let $name := *[1]/@Name, $scope := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::Initializer][1], $cls := ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration][1], $decl := (($scope//VariableId[@Name = $name]), ($cls/*/FieldDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId[@Name = $name]))[1], $type := $typeOf($decl) return exists(ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $name]) and exists($scope) and $type != '' and exists((($scope//VariableId[ancestor::*[self::FormalParameter or self::LocalVariableDeclaration][1]]), ($cls/*/FieldDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId)) [@Name != $name][$typeOf(.) = $type])]
